text: DSH Assistant（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把 DSH 对话组织成个人助理，由主助理规划并委派给后台子代理执行。插件注册隐藏的助理和执行器预设，并在侧栏提供助理页面、会话切换、设置及微信标签页。助理可管理个人资料、人设、备忘、清单、项目和日程，提供每日简报、定时提醒、唤醒与静默时段，并支持上下文压缩和微信消息连接。适合希望在 DSH 中持续管理个人事务并分派较长任务的用户。需要 DeepSeek 账户；连接微信时需要微信账号，不需额外 API key。

DSH Assistant (Web DSH plugin) adds personal assistant and worker presets with delegated tasks, an assistant page and conversation switcher. It manages notes and schedules, sends briefs and reminders, and connects WeChat. Requires a DeepSeek account; WeChat integration requires WeChat.
想让 DSH 助理把复杂任务分给后台子代理处理。
我想在 DSH 里记录日程并收到提前提醒。
能不能让 DSH 每天早上给我一份日程简报？
我想给助理设定安静时段和稍后唤醒。
需要在 DSH 中保存个人资料、人设和常用备忘。
I want a DSH assistant that can delegate tasks to background workers.
DSH Assistant 功能「后台子代理委派」：主助理可把工作委派给后台执行器预设，并依据所选模型和工作区运行。
DSH Assistant 功能「日程简报与提醒」：心跳按本地时间生成每日简报、日程提醒和用户设置的唤醒，并遵循静默时段。
DSH Assistant 功能「微信连接」：绑定后，助理可经微信接收消息并路由回复。

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · dsh-assistant：English | [中文](README-zh.md)

A general-purpose chat agent for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), built on a **parent agent + worker sub-agent** architecture.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · dsh-assistant：The parent is the conversation: it plans, delegates, and approves. Workers do the work in the background. The design explores a more autonomous agent pattern, where the parent manages worker context, model and reasoning effort, workspace, and permission approval instead of the user operating every tool. Single-window self-management of the parent — its own context, model, and long-running work in one conversation — will be added progressively in later versions.
@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Requirements：**DeepSeek Harness Desktop `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`.** Only the Desktop app is supported; the web app and other hosts are not.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Install：Install `@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant` from the Plugins page of DSH Desktop, or from the command line:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant
```

The two sub-plugins `@starsharryzhu/complete-subagent` and `@starsharryzhu/im-robot` are installed with it.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Architecture：- **Parent (router)** — the chat. It talks to you, records simple facts with narrow tools over fixed files, and hands everything else to a worker with `delegate`. It has no general file writes, shell, web, or official subagent tool, so it never blocks on work and can take your next message at any time.
- **Workers** — background sub-agents on their own preset, with the working toolset. Each gets a `cwd` and may modify only that sub-workspace (plus temporary directories); anything else needs `request_write_access`, which the parent answers.
- **Parent as manager** — it chooses the worker's model and reasoning effort from the models you enable, passes your request in your own words, never polls for progress, and reports only results, decisions, or failures. Worker context stays out of the conversation; the parent's own context is compacted automatically at a configurable ratio (50% by default).
- **Permissions** — workspace write by default, with automatic refusal outside. The parent auto-approves in-workspace work that matches the task; a destructive or ambiguous change gets one plain-language question, never a modal. Each assistant

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · What you get：- A sidebar row that opens the last assistant's conversation; the conversation title switches between assistants or creates one (name, form of address, workspace).
- One long-running conversation per assistant, with automatic compaction.
- Model and reasoning effort per conversation, and a multi-select list of worker models.
- Records as plain files in the workspace: schedule (`ddl.md`), lists, memos, logs, profile, persona, projects. Passwords, card numbers, and ID numbers are never recorded.
- A schedule with reminders and a `/ddl` week view, a daily brief every morning, and a watchdog.
- A heartbeat instead of automation tasks: the assistant wakes on its own every hour, and to the minute for what is due, and it can set its own wake-ups. Whether a heartbeat with nothing due calls the model is a setting.
- Quiet hours, daily and temporary. Reminders inside them move to the evening before or the next morning; other WeChat messages wait for their end. The assistant changes them only when you ask.
- Your own time zone in the profile, worked out from where you say you are and from your schedule, never from the device.
- A balance remi

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Settings：- **Plugins page** (shared by every assistant): worker models, compaction ratio, balance threshold and check interval, reminder wording, persona and profile limits.
- **Each assistant's Settings tab**: name and form of address, reminder lead time, daily brief time, heartbeat interval and idle wake, quiet hours, watchdog timeout, WeChat switch and message length. Its **Shared settings** button opens the Plugins page settings.
@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Settings：Numbers can be cleared and retyped; values are corrected when the field is left.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Sub-plugins：Pinned as exact versions in `dependencies` and mounted only inside the two hidden presets:

- `@starsharryzhu/complete-subagent` — the delegation tools, worker model choice, and write-access requests.
- `@starsharryzhu/im-robot` — the WeChat bridge.

Installing either one standalone switches the bundled copy off automatically.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Status and roadmap：Working today: the parent/worker split, per-worker model and reasoning effort, workspace confinement with parent-approved access, automatic compaction, records, schedule and reminders, heartbeats and quiet hours, WeChat in and out, and the watchdog.

Next: single-window self-management for the parent agent — its own context, model choice, and long-running work handled in the same conversation, with fewer handoffs and less supervision.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Known limits：- The sidebar's content search can still find assistant conversations.
- Heartbeats stop while the app is closed or the computer sleeps; what is still ahead is given on waking.
- The app keeps its own copy of every image and file shown in a conversation, even after `IM/WeChat/` has removed the original.
- Only tools are isolated; global prompt contexts injected by other plugins are not filtered.
- The assistant cannot send images or files to WeChat yet. Voice stays as raw SILK audio, with WeChat's transcript as its text.
- Workers cannot modify anything outside their workspace; on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 an approved path only reaches the write/edit tools, not shell commands.
- Verified on macOS with Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1; other systems are untested.

@starsharryzhu/dsh-assistant README · Development：```bash
node scripts/link-dev.mjs
npm test
```

`lib/` is a committed build artifact; run `node build.js` after changing `src/`.
